summary: A victim was approached by a person posing as a successful investor who built trust over several weeks and directed them to the ORVG trading platform. Fake profits were displayed until the victim attempted withdrawal and was instructed to pay a tax verification fee before access to funds was denied.
user_mistake: Trusted an online relationship that promoted a fake trading platform
prevention: Reject withdrawal related tax or verification payments/Independently verify trading platform licensing before depositing funds
